MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "General repair supplies fit alongside my nuts, bolts, washers and hooks; the single roll of duct tape is useful for securing or patching things without requiring a specialized project.",
    "Glue and general-purpose tape connect reasonably to my practical hardware purchases, even when I would not choose them immediately."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Electrical connectors and zero-clearance tape assume wiring or woodworking tasks that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The test kit and food portion cups do not support my current hardware interests, and my purchases give me no reason to need a gallon of degreaser.",
    "Ten packs of glue and twelve rolls of tape exceed my current needs, even though the products themselves are relevant."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying fasteners seems to have been taken as interest in specialized repair supplies of almost any kind, although the actual task matters to me.",
    "My purchases of hardware assortments and packs of hooks seem to have been taken as a preference for bulk quantities across other supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent hooks and fasteners point more directly toward attaching, securing and organizing things than toward electrical work or specialized woodworking.",
    "A relevant product still needs to fit a current use and a manageable quantity; I rarely choose something just because it might be useful someday."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in practical hardware but stretched it into unrelated tasks and quantities I do not currently need."
}
